propositions: ADF encoding is hardwired into Cloud path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, requiring separate implementations of the same field-mapping logic

Four distinct rich-text operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must be separately composable to preserve existing Cloud behavior where fit and normalize are applied in specific order by different callers

A Protocol-based RichTextCodec contract must enable both AdfCodec (Cloud) and WikiTextCodec (Data Center) implementations without duplicating map_fields_to_remote or allowing jira_family modules to import location-pinned adapters/jira modules
Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in the tree, relocated to adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py and taking the codec as a constructor dependency
WikiTextCodec must truncate at 32767 characters with a ' … [truncated by reconciler]' marker counted against the limit, matching the documented Jira Server/DC text-field cap
Cloud oracles from J1 must continue to pass with unmodified assertions, proving the codec refactoring is behavior-preserving for the existing Cloud path
